description: The restored Commonwealth fractures under the influence of the Collectors and the Abyss while Dylan searches for the Route of Ages and the deeper purpose behind his survival. Tyr returns as an enemy, Beka becomes a target of the Abyss, and the season culminates at Arkology with the Magog World Ship and Dylan embracing his identity as a Paradine.

s04e01.description: Dylan searches for remnants of the Commonwealth fleet after its political collapse and follows the trail toward the mysterious All Forces Nullification Point.

s04e02.description: A supposedly infallible augur named Citizen Eight maneuvers for power and threatens both Tri-Jema and Dylan's command.

s04e03.description: A mission leads Dylan to Kroton, the creator of the Magog World Ship, and a device capable of unleashing another catastrophe.

s04e04.description: The crew investigates a battle that appears never to have happened and Dylan is pulled into a psychological contest with hidden adversaries.

s04e05.description: Harper becomes central to a conflict between Nietzschean siblings involving hostages and a weapon that can erase higher brain function.

s04e06.description: Tyr returns allied with the Collectors and demands the Route of Ages map from his former crewmates.

s04e07.description: With Beka in Tyr's hands, Dylan races to keep the Route of Ages map away from the Collectors and the Abyss.

s04e08.description: A distress call from a Commonwealth prison draws Andromeda into a riot with larger consequences than it first appears.

s04e09.description: A scientific conference on the Magog threat is attacked while Dylan is abducted by the Collectors.

s04e10.description: The crew rescues a kidnapped princess whose account turns the supposed villain and her royal father into much less obvious figures.

s04e11.description: With the Collectors dominating the Commonwealth, Dylan and his crew are placed on trial and forced to defend everything they have done.

s04e12.description: A smuggled shipment of living bio-armor leads the crew toward a much more dangerous source than expected.

s04e13.description: An experimental cloaking device throws Dylan into an alternate reality where familiar people and events have taken a different path.

s04e14.description: Andromeda encounters two groups locked in a seemingly endless war whose origins have been forgotten.

s04e15.description: Rev Bem returns with knowledge of a possible weapon against the Abyss, but insists Dylan meet him personally.

s04e16.description: The Abyss takes control of Beka, forcing the crew to fight for her mind without destroying the person they are trying to save.

s04e17.description: Dylan, Harper and Rhade are captured by Templars while Beka, Trance and Rommie pursue a separate lead involving a smuggler.

s04e18.description: An emissary claiming continued loyalty to Tri-Jema arrives aboard Andromeda, leaving Dylan unsure whether she is ally, spy or both.

s04e19.description: Andromeda cuts Rommie off from the ship after her emotions begin destabilizing critical systems.

s04e20.description: A figure from Beka's past dies while pursuing something the Abyss also wants, leaving the crew to finish his search first.

s04e21.description: Andromeda escorts envoys returning from peace talks with the Magog as the World Ship closes in on the Arkology.

s04e22.description: Dylan makes a final stand at Arkology against the approaching Magog World Ship and embraces his role as a Paradine.
